items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 27 October 2026 at 8:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Gales at first, then strong winds.


##Synopsis##

A very deep area of low pressure will track north of Scotland, associated fronts clearing Britain today.


##Wind##

Southwest 7 or gale 8, decreasing West or Southwest 6 or 7 later this morning. Little change thereafter.


##State of Sea##

Rough or very rough, falling moderate or rough this morning.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Decreasing West or Southwest 5 or 6 through the rest of tomorrow morning, or 5 in the afternoon, then backing South or Southwest 3 or 4 overnight into Thursday.


##State of Sea##

Moderate occasionally rough at first, becoming slight or moderate later tomorrow, slight overnight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good.
